svg.title: chauvet-cave-bear-remains - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Generalized cave-bear body illustrates the taxon associated with bone evidence, not a specimen, live encounter or proof of human-bear co-presence.
